selection_policy.candidate_pool: all explicit run-pass/build-pass/run-fail primary .rs in the listed UI directories; no source rewriting
selection_policy.priority: assertion-bearing first, then increasing source byte length, then lexical upstream path
selection_policy.membership_policy: batch 01 uses the original version-1 classifier and quotas; later capability corrections block members without replacement
selection_policy.excluded_scope_reason: first batch targets integer/control-flow/reference/aggregate/enum/call/drop/panic behavior; other suites/directories remain outside this declared candidate pool
selection_policy.blocked_policy: conservative lexical capability checks; raw protocol still must be interpreted per revision by the runner
selection_policy.execution_policy: selection is not a pass result; runner reports every selected revision and all blocked/excluded candidates separately

selection_batch.historical_results_policy: prior results retain their original manifest fingerprint and counts; reclassification does not rewrite batch history
